_about: Everything the pipeline needs is decided here, before any download. Change values here, never inside the scripts.

study_area.name: Northern NSW (Richmond, Clarence, Tweed and nearby basins)

catchment_rule._why: Gauged catchments with published boundaries and attributes (CAMELS-AUS v2), small enough for flash floods, fully inside one radar domain.

period._why: Rainfields3 on NCI starts 2019-06-08; 72 h of history makes 2019-06-11 the first issue time. Data after June 2026 is still provisional.

split._why: Chronological by water year so one storm never sits in two sets; Lismore floods held out as an extreme test.

time.convention: a value stamped h covers (h - 1 h, h]

label.rule: 1 if a flood onset at the outlet gauge falls in (issue, issue + 6 h]
label.threshold: official minor flood level if given in manual_thresholds, else the percentile below of the gauge's hourly maximum level over TRAIN years only (holdout excluded)
label._onset_note: A rise above the threshold after fewer hours below is merged into the previous event (its hours are excluded from scoring, never labelled 0). 6 h keeps a second flood peak after a short dip as its own onset (e.g. 27 Feb 2022 at 203010).

radar._note: 15-min merged gauge/radar accumulation (mm); files are stamped with the END of the 15 minutes (UTC)
radar._qc_note: An hour is also bad if rain_max >= qc_max_mm_per_hour (65535 fill code = 3276.7 mm passes through as a number) or if rain_max repeats the same value >= qc_stuck_hours in a row while >= qc_stuck_min_mm (stuck artefact, e.g. 204056 in April 2024).

qc_exclude.reason: Suspected radar/gauge-merge artefact: 10-17 mm/h catchment mean for ~8 days (987 mm in 72 h, about twice any other catchment) while the river peaked at only 1.96 m. Found with notebooks/inspect_data.ipynb section 5.

radar._qc_exclude_note: Manual exclusions after inspection. Each entry must give a reason; hours inside are treated as missing radar.

soil._note: AWRA-L v7 daily, 0.05 deg; s0 = 0-0.1 m, ss = 0.1-1 m (mm). Each hour uses the value of the local day before that hour's date, so the value is always complete before the hour.

manual_files._how: Download these two files by hand from https://zenodo.org/records/14289037 and put them in data/manual/
